profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google Creative Lab
profile.summary:
Software engineer and creative building end-to-end — from training ML models to designing the interfaces that make AI usable by anyone. Over nearly a decade at Google Creative Lab, the experiments I've built have become products used by millions, the prototypes have become team-owned platforms.



The projects I'm most proud of sit in the space between technical possibility and human need. Teachable Machine lets anyone train an ML model with no code — I architected its interface, implemented the transfer learning and hold a patent for the node-based classification system at its core. Creatability, which won the Cannes Grand Prix for Design, is a library of open-source assistive interfaces I built with the disability community using TensorFlow.js and PoseNet. More recently, I created the Gemini Live API Web Console — one of the most popular open-source projects in Google's Gemini organization — and have contributed demos for several major model launches.



The through-line across all of it is the work that happens in the messy middle, translating between researchers, designers, and business teams when the idea is still taking shape, and turning that ambiguity into something that ships. That translation work is deeply human. I think the boundaries between "creative" and "engineer" are collapsing, and my career has been a long argument that they were always artificial.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Building software at the intersection of AI, creative tooling, and interaction design. Working across research and product teams to turn emerging capabilities into tools and products that people love.

positions.title: Creative Technologist
positions.description:
Bridged research, design, and engineering to build AI-powered experiences that brought Google's technology to broad public audiences. Architected and developed full-stack applications from concept through production, collaborating across research teams, product teams, and external partners.

  - Created Teachable Machine — a no-code ML training tool used by millions, published at ACM CHI, with a patent for its node-based classification interface

  - Built Creatability — open-source assistive interfaces using TensorFlow.js and PoseNet, winner of the Cannes Grand Prix for Design

  - Created AutoDraw (#1 Product Hunt launch of 2017) and a core contributor to Google's AI Experiments / labs.google

  - Work regularly presented on stage and online by Google leadership including at I/O and other keynotes

positions.title: Tech Lead
positions.description: Lead and support the B-Reel team in technology decisions and planning. Work includes development of internal tools, libraries, processes, writing technical specifications and planning new projects from brief to completion.

positions.title: Freelance Lead Developer
positions.description: Worked with the awesome team at http://madeinhaus.com on interactive experiences. Lead the front-end development team in completing challenging applications for clients. Developed, tested and documented custom tooling and reusable processes for structuring the teams development approach.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description: Worked with the LAB at Rockwell Group on large installation projects.

positions.title: Adjunct Faculty
positions.description: Instructor for MCAD's Database and Computational Design course for Web and Multimedia Environments.

company.name: Minneapolis College of Art and Design

positions.title: Director of Creative Development
positions.description: Lead the team of Knowledge Visualization Systems. KVS is a small company working to improve the way people learn from complex information. While at KVS we focused on leveraging emerging web technologies: HTML5, Canvas, WebGL, etc. for creating advanced data, knowledge and systems visualizations.

positions.title: Interaction Designer/Developer
positions.description: Worked for several clients, maintained long-term business relationships building a cohesive vision across web, print and motion media. Designed/developed working alongside agencies/other designers.

positions.title: Interactive Creative Developer
positions.description: Develop, plan, strategize and direct on a variety of interactive media projects.

positions.title: Interactive Media Designer
positions.description: Work included designing and developing a dynamic brand extension, a billboard, multimedia presentations for brand development, design and development of projects for external clients.

company.name: Minneapolis College of Art and Design's DesignWorks

positions.title: Artist-in-Residence
positions.description: Summer residency working as a designer/developer for The Studio for Interactive Media. Worked on physical installations for Adobe, Coca-Cola and the LAB at Rockwellgroup, as well as a project developing a product prototype. The members of TSFIM have now split between running Adapted Studio and The School of Interactive Media at Brand New School.

positions.title: In-House Graphic Designer
positions.description: Work included an identity, website, clothing, ATV graphics kits, DVD Packaging and print advertisements.

projects.title: Toxiclibs.js
projects.description: Toxiclibs.js is an open-source javascript library for visualization and other forms of computational design oriented towards HTML5 technologies.

projects.title: What You Pay For
projects.description: Visualize your personal federal tax contribution and where your money goes, for 2011.
